name: World of Phenomena
source:
In a world of magic, Luana and Hatil set out to find Aidan, who was like a father to them. He had promised to return home in a couple weeks, but never came back. On their journey, they come across many strange events known as phenomena: strange and unexplainable occurrences. These phenomena are a side effect of magic. Sometimes, they bring great miracles. But other times, they cause terrifying disasters.

Luana and Hatil are caught by numerous disastrous phenomena. They as well as others are swept along with the whims of phenomena. Their formerly simple journey expands and they find their fates intertwined with the secrets of the world.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=56008]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
在魔法世界中，卢安娜和哈蒂尔出发寻找艾丹，艾丹对他们来说就像父亲一样。他曾答应几周后回家，但再也没有回来。在他们的旅程中，他们遇到了许多被称为现象的奇怪事件：奇怪且无法解释的事件。这些现象都是魔法的副作用。有时，他们会带来伟大的奇迹。但有时，它们也会造成可怕的灾难。

卢安娜和哈蒂尔遭遇了许多灾难性的现象。他们和其他人一样，都被现象的突发奇想所左右。他们原本简单的旅程不断扩展，他们发现自己的命运与世界的秘密交织在一起。
